concerns.text: Duplicate functional requirement identifier FR-001 appears in the Spec Template section as a placeholder, conflicting with the earlier concrete FR-001 defined in the Functional Requirements section. This creates ambiguity about which FR-001 is authoritative.
The inclusion of a generic 'Spec Template' with placeholder requirements (e.g., FR-001‑006) is inappropriate for a finalized specification document and introduces redundant terminology and IDs.
